comments.text:
Implement ToneSelector modal Vizia view with dual-mode browsing (bank + category).

DEPENDS ON: i7-49c.13 (MixerPage)

TWO BROWSING MODES (toggle at bottom):
1. By Tone & Bank: left panel shows bank groups (SN Acoustic/Synth/Drum, PCM Synth/Drum, GM2, Expansion), right panel shows tone list for selected bank
2. By Category: left panel shows category grid (37 categories), right panel shows all tones in selected category across all banks

TONE LIST: Scrollable list with tone number, category abbreviation (bank mode) or bank badge (category mode), and tone name. Active tone highlighted. Click selects tone and calls changePartTone().

DATA SOURCE: Uses factoryTonesJson() from integral-core for preset banks (instant, no MIDI needed). User banks would need MIDI catalog queries.

REFERENCE:
- web/src/ToneSelector.tsx: full dual-mode implementation
- web/src/ToneSelector.module.css: modal styling
- web/src/toneCatalog.ts: ToneCatalog service with category index
- web/src/categories.ts: category names, IDs, abbreviations
- web/src/toneBanks.ts: bank definitions (MSB/LSBs per bank)

title: VST/Vizia: implement ToneSelector modal with bank and category modes
